column1: # Measured tests of the auth race split packages of ci/auth_race_splits.tsv (CHAOS-13693): package<TAB>TestName<TAB>seconds. An
# auth race leg (check_go.sh auth race-leg) cuts a split package's `go test -race -list` names into its parts by these rows
# (ci/go_race_shard.awk cut(), as ci/go_test_split_weights.tsv for the test legs): a measured name longest first onto the lightest
# part, any other name by a hash of its own name, so adding or removing an unmeasured test moves no other test. The auth plan does
# not read the rows for weights: a part weighs ceil(W / parts) as before (W = the package row of ci/go_race_weights.d).
# seconds = round(W * median over runs of e/E): e = the test's top-level elapsed, E = the summed top-level elapsed of the package's
# tests in that run. Source (same flags as the auth race leg: -race, no build tag): the go-test-timings-race-K-of-6 artifacts
# (go-quality.yml) of 4 successful go-quality push runs on main (43376042584, 43377857475, 43379257796, 43443132054), median over 4.
# Rows: every listed test of 2 s or more, and the package's heaviest tests up to its part count (no part can be empty).
# A row must name a test `go test -race -list` reports: renaming or removing a measured test needs its row edited in the same
# change (the auth race leg and internal/cigates/testshard fail otherwise). Refresh: the same reduction over newer runs; values
# only cost balance. Sorted (LC_ALL=C) by package, then test.
